note: Gaines County publishes no zoning districts service: the county GIS (gis.bisclient.com/gainescad) offers parcels only and the county's GIS data is a paid download. Texas counties have little zoning authority. Seminole's zoning ordinance is kept on file at city hall, not posted; no city zoning layer was found on ArcGIS. Seagraves publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (viewer-only).
